quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave Unveils CoreWeave Physical AI Launchables, Taking (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave unveiled CoreWeave Physical AI Launchables, a catalog of physical AI workloads packaged as Templates built and tested by CoreWeave engineers for robotics, autonomous vehicle and simulation teams, run against reserved capacity or as burst jobs. At launch the Templates span five tools (NVIDIA Isaac Sim, CARLA, MuJoCo, NVIDIA AlpaSim and NVIDIA Cosmos 3) and include the new Cosmos Data Factory agentic skills, plus CoreWeave's own agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents. CoreWeave says it is also working with physical AI software providers to run their products on CoreWeave infrastructure, naming as partners Cadence, Convergent Science, Encord, nTop, PhysicsX and Voxel51.
quarterly_data.figure: Templates span five tools at launch
